comparison.objective: Commission an adjustable shock absorber vs install a spring cage fastener in a rack opening.
comparison.physical_skill: Loosen a captive setscrew, withdraw/reinsert a hex bit, rotate and lock a collar, then tune dynamic response vs compress retaining legs and insert a fastener.
comparison.success_condition: Two force- and travel-bounded impact cycles with setting retention vs successful cage-fastener seating; the record gives no numeric seating thresholds.
comparison.reason: Both involve small industrial hardware, but compression/insertion of a cage fastener is not adjustment, relocking, or dynamic commissioning.
